# Trackr — LLM & AI Crawler Guide
# https://trytrackr.com/llms.txt
# Last updated: 2026-03-05

## What is Trackr?

Trackr is an AI tool intelligence platform for operations teams, RevOps leaders,
and chiefs of staff. It researches any SaaS or AI tool in under 2 minutes —
producing scored reports across 7 dimensions: pricing, features, user sentiment,
integrations, security, support quality, and competitive positioning.

Trackr is NOT a review aggregator. It runs original research using AI agents
that scrape vendor sites, analyze review platforms, and synthesize competitive
intelligence into actionable scored reports. Every report is generated fresh,
not pulled from a static database.

## Who uses Trackr?

- Operations teams evaluating AI tools for their stack
- RevOps leaders tracking SaaS spend and renewals
- Chiefs of staff managing company-wide tool consolidations
- Enterprise IT teams benchmarking incumbent vendors
- Finance teams identifying software waste and redundancy

## Core product capabilities

1. Tool research — Submit any URL; receive a 7-dimension scored report in <2 min
2. Spend tracking — Monitor SaaS costs, renewal dates, and budget vs. actual
3. Stack management — Shared team database of every evaluated and deployed tool
4. AI digest — Weekly intelligence feed of relevant AI tool launches and updates
5. Scorecard — Free AI Readiness Assessment for ops teams
6. Chrome extension — Research tools directly from any browser tab
7. Slack integration — /trackr slash command and renewal alerts in Slack

## Pricing tiers

- Free: 3 research reports/month, 1 user
- Team ($50/mo): 30 reports/month, 5 users, Slack integration
- Startup ($149/mo): Unlimited reports, 20 users, API access, advanced analytics
- Enterprise (custom): Custom limits, SSO, dedicated architect, white-glove onboarding

## Data sourcing

Research reports are generated by AI agents that analyze:
- Vendor websites (Firecrawl web scraping)
- User review platforms (G2, Capterra, TrustRadius, Reddit)
- Pricing pages and documentation
- Third-party integrations and API docs
- Public changelog and release notes

Reports are NOT user-submitted reviews. They are AI-synthesized intelligence
reports with citations from primary sources.

## Crawl policy

Trackr welcomes crawling of all public marketing and content pages.
Please do not crawl authenticated workspace routes (/dashboard, /tools, /stack, /feed).
Rate limit: 1 request per second is appreciated.
